notes: City of Lubbock, TX (Lubbock County), within city limits. PROVISIONAL source: Lubbock Appraisal District's own export and GIS are not reachable, so this is built from TxGIO StratMap 2026 land parcels for Lubbock County (collected from Lubbock CAD 2026-07-01; tax year 2026). Built by data/jurisidictions/run_lubbock.py (stratmap_county.py, shared runner tx_multicounty.py). 101,062 parcels, $4.04B land.

StratMap's Lubbock edition carries land and market value, owner and legal description, but no improvement value, state class, exemption flag or city code. So: improvement = market - land; the property category comes from the City of Lubbock's zoning district (NewZoning_UDC, 2023) at each parcel, with no improvement value meaning vacant (92% of parcels fall in a zoning district; the rest are 'Other' or vacant); exemptions come from owner names (city, county, ISDs, Texas Tech, LCU, hospital district, housing authority, churches) and from a $0 recorded market value (railway and public right-of-way): 2,395 records dropped. Categories and exemptions are therefore approximate.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4845000 (no taxing-unit code to cross-check).
Condos: 447 units in 29 developments merged onto their land. 83 remnants / strips hidden.

Singularity sweep: commercial land in the Overton redevelopment district by Texas Tech ($12-20/sqft) sits next to older east-side lots Lubbock CAD values near $0.25/sqft (Chapman, Baker subdivisions: ~$2,000 a lot), so ratios reach 50-85x there; these are the district's values. No hex towers (max hex ~ $11/sqft).
Over 100k parcels: PMTiles with H3 hexes, tiles verified against the source.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 1,552 lots, 653.2 acres, $117M est. land value. apply_parking_category.py tagged 151 parcels 'Parking Lot'.
Links: Lubbock CAD's property page by quick-ref id (lubbockcad.org/Property-Detail/PropertyQuickRefID/<R id>; confirmed by the user).
